disposition.reason: 22 of 24 conditional contrasts do not establish the frozen 99% upper-bound <= +1% non-regression requirement; no conditional interval establishes a slowdown.
disposition.production_behaviour: Retain the pre-candidate production path and feature-only diagnostics; archive the paired-column candidate.
disposition.remaining_bottleneck: Baseline diagnosis identifies gather-locality headroom; without a selected-candidate re-profile, remaining candidate bottlenecks and causal attribution of the primary saving are unproved.

interpretation: Ratios use arithmetic means, candidate/reference minus one, with unchanged conservative 99% per-case intervals. The verdict field is the separate legacy +/-5% timing label; gate_passed applies the frozen incremental policy. reference/packed mean baseline/candidate, both with the default encoder selector. RSS and CPU are whole-process measurements, distinct from codec allocation. No family-wide confidence or post-selection timing claim.
